label.purpose: Buttons and the status stamp, uppercase.

data.purpose: Mono register for the log, config, paths.

motion.name: log-cursor
motion.value: animation: cursor 1.1s steps(2, start) infinite; @keyframes cursor { 50% { opacity: 0.15; } }
motion.purpose: The pulsing block cursor at the end of the live log.

motion.name: running-pulse
motion.value: .dot.running::before { animation: core 0.69s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes core { 0%,100% { transform: scale(0.9); background-color: var(--accent); } 30% { transform: scale(1.5); background-color: var(--accent-faint); } }
motion.purpose: One modest swell on the running step: the core rises over the first third of the cycle (0.9x to 1.5x, accent to faint), then eases back. Speed is 1.6x the log cursor's blink (cursor 1.1s to core ~0.69s).

motion.name: led-pulse
motion.purpose: The header status LED breathes only while the launch is in progress (body.running).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ultramarine-filled primary action; darkens on hover/press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2f6fe4; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2f6fe4; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2258c4; border-color: #2258c4; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f6fe4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Ghost button: transparent, hairline border, ink text; fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: transparent; color: #161616; border: 1px solid #e5e5e2; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease-out, border-color .15s ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #f6f6f4; border-color: #161616; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2f6fe4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Ghost danger: red hairline and text; fills red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: transparent; color: #c6352e; border: 1px solid #c6352e; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #c6352e; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Uppercase status note with an 8px currentColor square.
components.css: .ds-status { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: 'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2457c4; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Step Row
components.description: Ruled checklist row: a double-layer square indicator (pending: two empty outlines; running: the inner core swells and pales — size + colour — inside the static accent ring; done: filled green with a theme-aware check; error: filled red with a cross; skipped: dimmed + struck title) + title + message.
components.html:
1. 启动 dsh
    正在启动…
components.css: .ds-steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-steps li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 24px minmax(0,1fr); column-gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 0; border-top: 1px solid #e5e5e2; } .ds-steps li:first-child { border-top: none; } .ds-dot { position: relative; width: 18px; height: 18px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #e5e5e2; } .ds-dot::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border: 1px solid #5f5f66; } .ds-dot.running { border-color: #2f6fe4; } .ds-dot.running::before { border: none; background: #2f6fe4; } .ds-dot.done { background: #0b7c4e; border-color: #0b7c4e; } .ds-dot.done::before { width: 9px; height: 5px; border: none; border-left: 2px solid var(--fill-ink); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--fill-ink); transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(-1px,-1px); } .ds-dot.error { background: #c6352e; border-color: #c6352e; } .ds-dot.error::before, .ds-dot.error::after { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; content: ''; width: 11px; height: 2px; border: none; background: var(--fill-ink); } .ds-dot.error::before { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-dot.error::after { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-45deg); } .ds-t { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-m { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 12px; color: #5f5f66; }

components.name: Config Table
components.description: Two-column ruled table: muted mono keys, accent-soft mono values.
components.css: .ds-kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9em 1fr; column-gap: 16px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-kv .ds-k, .ds-kv .ds-v { padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-kv .ds-k { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #5f5f66; } .ds-kv .ds-v { color: #2457c4; word-break: break-all; }

components.name: Terminal Log
components.description: Surface panel with mono text and the pulsing ultramarine block cursor. Pinned to the end while the user is at the bottom; stays put once they scroll up.
components.css: .ds-log { margin: 0; padding: 16px 18px; max-height: 185px; overflow-y: auto; background: #f6f6f4; border: 1px solid #e5e5e2; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: #e5e5e2 transparent; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','Cascadia Code',Consolas,monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.65; color: #161616; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-log::after { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 14px; margin-left: 5px; vertical-align: text-bottom; background: #2f6fe4; animation: ds-cur 1.1s steps(2,start) infinite; } @keyframes ds-cur { 50% { opacity: 0.15; } }

narrative.overview: DSHL is the launch console of a developer tool rendered in the Swiss International tradition: calm, objective, and ruled by the grid. It refuses both the decorated product dashboard and its own previous heavy brutalism. There is no decoration to admire — only measured type on a clean ground, hairline rules that hold content in place, one ultramarine accent that says this is the live thing, and a checklist that reads like a stamped sequence. The page has no fixed mood: it follows the operating system. On a white ground it is a printed program card; on a near-black ground it is a darkroom control panel. Status green, amber, and red are functional signals, never decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One accent. Ultramarine (#2F6FE4) marks the primary action, the running state, and key values; green/amber/red report status.
The grid does the work: hairline rules (1px), tracked uppercase section labels, tabular numerals, generous whitespace.
Square corners, no shadows, no gradients — flat Swiss paint.
The display voice is the self-hosted Inter grotesque.
Light and dark are both authored, not defaulted — the page follows the OS via prefers-color-scheme.
One authored calm motion set reserved for live states: the log cursor blinks, and the running step core plus the status LED breathe while the launch is in progress.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine is the only hue. Green, amber, and red exist solely as status signals; any other chromatic color breaks the instrument.

rules.name: The Theme Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are both designed, never inherited. The page follows the OS through prefers-color-scheme; it never offers its own toggle.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where code or machine output is shown — the log. Everything else speaks in the grotesque; mono headings would be costume.

dos: Do build structure with 1px hairlines and whitespace; the grid is the design.
Do spend ultramarine only on the primary action, the running state, and key values.
Do author both light and dark grounds and let the OS choose.
Do use square corners, tabular numerals, and tracked uppercase labels.
Do keep the self-hosted Inter as the voice; reserve mono for the log.
Do let the log follow the user: pinned to the end until they scroll up.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients, rounded corners, or glows.
Don't add a second accent hue; keep green/amber/red purely functional.
Don't use a system sans as the display voice.
Don't use glyph icons or emoji; carry status with the double-layer square, checks, and crosses.
Don't reserve a fixed placeholder for the action bar; measure its real height.
Don't add motion beyond the three live signals — the log cursor, the running step's breathing core, and the status LED while launching.
